name: CUMYL-PICA
summary: CUMYL-PICA (SGT-56) is an indole-3-carboxamide based synthetic cannabinoid. It is the α,α-dimethylbenzyl analogue of SDB-006.

pharmacology.text: CUMYL-PICA acts as an agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with Ki values of 59.21 nM at CB1 and 136.38 nM at CB2 and EC50 values of 11.98 nM at CB1 and 16.2 nM at CB2.

uses.text: It was briefly sold in New Zealand during 2013 as an ingredient of at the time legal synthetic cannabis products, but the product containing CUMYL-BICA and CUMYL-PICA was denied an interim licensing approval under the Psychoactive Substances regulatory scheme, due to reports of adverse events in consumers.

summaryZh: SGT-56（也稱為CUMYL-PICA）是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C23H28N2O，帶有吲哚-3-甲醯胺結構，與其同系物SDB-006都為人工合成的大麻素。
